q: What does Nedlloyd Logistics do?
a: Nedlloyd Logistics India Pvt. Ltd. is an integrated Project Logistics Management company — air, sea and land freight, customs brokerage, warehousing, project cargo and heavy lift, charter, 4PL, courier, e-commerce fulfilment and reverse logistics — pan-India and connected globally.

q: When was Nedlloyd founded?
a: Nedlloyd Logistics India Pvt. Ltd. was incorporated in New Delhi in December 2001.

q: Where is your head office?
a: T-95A, 4th Floor, C.L. House, Yusuf Sarai Commercial Centre, Gautam Nagar, New Delhi-110049, India.

q: Which countries do you operate in?
a: India (pan-India network), the USA (Austin, Miami, Cleveland), Canada (Mississauga) and the UAE, plus a global partner network through the WCA alliance.

q: Which industries do you specialise in?
a: Oil & Gas, Power, BESS / battery storage, Solar, Wind, EPC & Infrastructure, Steel & Cement, Automotive, Rail, Defence, Telecom and Heavy Engineering.

q: Who are some of your clients?
a: Sony, BSNL, Alstom, HP, Jindal, Haier, Somany, Teracom and Javi Systems are among the enterprises that have moved cargo with Nedlloyd.

q: Are you certified?
a: Yes — ISO 9001:2015 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environment), OHSAS 18001 (Health & Safety) and WCA Network membership.

q: What is your company motto?
a: T E A M — Together Everyone Achieves More.

q: What are Nedlloyd's core values?
a: Client value creation, Best people, Respect for individuals, Integrity and Business excellence.

q: How many warehouses do you operate?
a: More than 20 IT-enabled warehouses across India linked to our distribution network.

q: Are you an asset-based or non-asset-based provider?
a: Both. We coordinate our own facilities and equipment alongside vetted partner carriers; as a 4PL we act as a singularly accountable, non-asset-based integrator when that serves the client best.

q: Do you work with international partners?
a: Yes. Nedlloyd is a WCA Network partner and has its own offices in the USA and Canada, giving reliable coverage on every major trade lane.

q: Can you handle cargo for government or PSU projects?
a: Yes. We have supported PSU, telecom and infrastructure programmes and handle the documentation and compliance those contracts require.

q: How big is the Nedlloyd team?
a: Around 50–60 logistics professionals across India and our international offices, supported by partner networks at every port and hub.

q: How do I download your company profile?
a: Use the ⬇ Company Profile button in the top bar on any page — it downloads a two-page PDF.

q: How do I request a quote?
a: Tap Get a Quote (bottom right), WhatsApp +91 99106 94210, call +91 11 4986 6666 or email info@nedlloydgroup.com.

q: What information do you need for a quote?
a: Origin, destination, cargo details (weight, dimensions, pieces, hazardous class if any), Incoterms, target dates and any site or handling constraints.

q: How fast do you respond?
a: Within one business day; urgent project or charter enquiries are usually answered the same day.

q: Do you provide fixed rates?
a: We offer spot quotes and contract rates depending on volume and lane. Project cargo is quoted per movement after a route and feasibility check.

q: Are there charges beyond the freight rate?
a: Customs duties and taxes, terminal handling, port charges, permits, escorts, cranes and any special handling are itemised separately in every quote.

q: Can I get a quote in USD?
a: Yes — quotes can be issued in INR, USD or other major currencies as required.

q: Do you offer consolidated pricing for multiple shipments?
a: Yes. Programme and contract pricing is available for recurring lanes and multi-shipment projects.

q: Is a site visit needed for project cargo quotes?
a: For heavy or over-dimensional cargo we normally do a route survey and site assessment before confirming the plan and price.

q: Do you quote door-to-door?
a: Yes — pick-up, international freight, customs at both ends and final delivery under one Job Number.

q: Can I request a quote for warehousing only?
a: Yes. Storage, handling and distribution can be quoted independently of freight.

q: What air freight options do you offer?
a: Express, priority and deferred air freight through globally reliable airlines, plus full and part air charter for urgent or oversized cargo.

q: Which airports do you operate from in India?
a: All major gateways including Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad and Kolkata.

q: Can you move dangerous goods by air?
a: Yes — DG-trained staff handle classification, packing, labelling and documentation under IATA rules.

q: What is the typical transit time India–USA by air?
a: Airport-to-airport is usually 2–4 days; door-to-door including customs is typically 5–8 days.

q: Do you handle temperature-sensitive air cargo?
a: Yes, including pharma and perishables with cool-chain handling at origin and destination.

q: Can you charter an aircraft for a single shipment?
a: Yes. We arrange full and part charters for time-critical project spares, defence equipment and oversized components.

q: What documents are needed for air export from India?
a: Commercial invoice, packing list, shipping bill, AWB, and any licences or certificates relevant to the commodity.

q: Do you track air shipments?
a: Yes — AWB and customs milestones appear on your dashboard as they happen.

q: Can you handle air freight for e-commerce parcels?
a: Yes, including consolidation, customs and last-mile delivery for cross-border e-commerce.

q: Do you offer airport-to-door service abroad?
a: Yes, through our own offices in the USA and Canada and WCA partners elsewhere.

q: Do you offer FCL and LCL?
a: Yes — full container load, less-than-container load, breakbulk and RO/RO.

q: Can you ship out-of-gauge cargo by sea?
a: Yes — flat racks, open tops, breakbulk and heavy-lift vessels for over-dimensional cargo.

q: Which Indian ports do you work from?
a: Nhava Sheva (JNPT), Mundra, Chennai, Kolkata/Haldia, Visakhapatnam, Kandla, Cochin and others as required.

q: What is the typical India–Europe sea transit?
a: Roughly 18–28 days port-to-port depending on the lane and carrier.

q: Do you provide container stuffing near the port?
a: Yes — our warehouses near ports act as extensions of the factory for stuffing and consolidation.

q: Can you arrange sea charter?
a: Yes — part and full charters for project cargo and heavy lift.

q: Do you handle RO/RO for vehicles and rolling stock?
a: Yes, including metro coaches, locomotives and construction machinery.

q: Do you manage carrier contracts?
a: Yes — we manage carrier contracts, space allocation and shipment planning across key trade lanes.

q: Can you ship personal effects or household goods?
a: Our focus is industrial and project cargo; we can advise on suitable partners for household moves.

q: Do you insure sea freight?
a: Freight and marine cargo insurance can be arranged for every movement.

q: Do you provide road transport across India?
a: Yes — road and rail across India's industrial corridors, ports and inland hubs, from pre-carriage to destination delivery.

q: Can you move heavy and over-dimensional cargo by road?
a: Yes — hydraulic axles, low-beds, route surveys, permits and escorts for ODC across multiple states.

q: Do you use rail?
a: Yes — rail and multimodal solutions for bulk, containers and project cargo where it improves cost or reliability.

q: How do you manage multi-state permits?
a: Our project team handles route surveys, state permits, escorts and police/NHAI clearances before the convoy moves.

q: Do you provide last-mile delivery to project sites?
a: Yes — including remote sites, with site coordination and delivery sequencing.

q: Can you provide dedicated fleet for a plant?
a: Yes — dedicated and contract vehicles for in-plant and inbound/outbound logistics.

q: Do you track trucks in real time?
a: Every leg is a tracked milestone with POD capture; GPS tracking is available on request.

q: Do you handle hazardous goods by road?
a: Yes, with compliant vehicles, drivers and documentation.

q: Can you move cargo to Nepal, Bangladesh or Bhutan by road?
a: Yes — cross-border road movements with customs handled at the land border.

q: What is your typical Delhi–Mumbai road transit?
a: Around 3–4 days for standard cargo; ODC convoys are planned individually.

q: Do you provide customs clearance?
a: Yes — licensed brokerage at origin and destination: import/export documentation, classification, duties and bonds, shipping bills and BOE/DO filings.

q: What is a Bill of Entry?
a: The import declaration filed with Indian Customs; Nedlloyd files it and attaches it to the Customs (Destination) milestone on your dashboard.

q: Can you advise on HS classification and duty?
a: Yes — our brokers advise on commodity classification, duty rates, exemptions and restrictions before cargo moves.

q: Do you handle project imports and registration with Customs?
a: Yes — project registration, reconciliation and closure with Customs is part of our project cargo service.

q: Do you handle DGFT licences and export incentives?
a: We assist with licence applications and scheme documentation through our compliance team.

q: Can you clear cargo at any Indian port or airport?
a: Yes — through our own teams and partners at every major gateway.

q: Do you handle customs in the USA and Canada?
a: Yes — Nedlloyd Logistics Americas and Nedlloyd Logistics Canada work with licensed brokers at destination.

q: How long does customs clearance take in India?
a: Typically 1–3 working days for compliant documentation; project and restricted cargo may take longer.

q: What documents do I need to import into India?
a: Commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or AWB, IEC, and any licences, certificates or BIS/other approvals for the commodity.

q: Do you provide bonded warehousing?
a: Yes — custom-bonded public warehouses for high-value and regulated imports.

q: What warehousing services do you provide?
a: General, custom-bonded public, temperature-controlled and project-based warehousing with inventory management and distribution.

q: Where are your warehouses?
a: Across India including Delhi (Rangpuri), Mumbai (Bhiwandi), Bangalore (Tumkur Road) and Kolkata (Dankuni), plus partner facilities.

q: Do you provide real-time inventory visibility?
a: Yes — all warehouses are IT-enabled and inventory is visible on your dashboard.

q: Can you store telecom or power equipment for projects?
a: Yes — project warehousing stores, kits and sequences costly equipment for site delivery.

q: Do you offer temperature-controlled storage?
a: Yes, for sensitive goods.

q: Do you provide e-commerce fulfilment?
a: Yes — pick and pack, order processing, returns and last-mile distribution.

q: Can you manage reverse logistics?
a: Yes — returns, repairs, replacements and recovery through the same tracked milestones.

q: Do you provide value-added services in the warehouse?
a: Yes — kitting, labelling, packing, consolidation and quality checks.

q: What are your warehouse security standards?
a: 24×7 security, CCTV, access control and insurance cover; details available on request.

q: Can I visit a warehouse before contracting?
a: Yes — contact us to arrange a site visit.

q: What counts as project cargo?
a: Heavy, over-dimensional or high-value equipment moved for a project — transformers, turbines, reactors, rolling stock, plant machinery.

q: What is the heaviest piece you have moved?
a: We regularly move single pieces above 100 tonnes; each movement is engineered individually — contact us with your cargo details.

q: Do you do route surveys?
a: Yes — physical route surveys, bridge and clearance checks, and permit planning before every ODC movement.

q: Do you supervise loading and unloading?
a: Yes — on-site supervision through to placement, with cranes and hydraulic axles arranged as needed.

q: Can you move wind turbine blades and towers?
a: Yes — specialised blade trailers, escorts and multi-state permits with delivery matched to erection schedules.

q: Do you handle BESS containers?
a: Yes — DG-compliant lithium battery movements to substations and project sites.

q: Can you move transformers?
a: Yes — hydraulic axles, bridge assessments, crane placement and site delivery for power transformers.

q: Do you work with EPC contractors?
a: Yes — we plan freight around construction milestones and provide 4PL control across vendors.

q: Do you provide engineering drawings for load plans?
a: Yes — engineered load and lashing plans are prepared for heavy and OOG cargo.

q: Do you have Health & Safety procedures for heavy lifts?
a: Yes — OHSAS 18001-managed procedures with in-house H&S review.

q: How do I track my shipment?
a: Enter your Job Number in the assistant's Track shipment tab, on the Tracking page, or sign in to the Customer Dashboard.

q: What is a Job Number?
a: A single reference (e.g. NL-2026-0001) assigned at booking that follows the shipment through all ten milestones.

q: What are the ten milestones?
a: Booking Confirmed, Cargo Picked Up, Customs (Origin), Departed, In Transit, Arrived Destination, Customs (Destination), Out for Delivery, Delivered (POD), Job Closed.

q: Which documents are attached to milestones?
a: Booking Note, Invoice + Packing List, Shipping Bill, BL/AWB, BOE/DO and POD copy.

q: Who can see my shipments?
a: Role-based access: Nedlloyd Admin, your Client login, read-only logins you create for your own customers, and the Nedlloyd employees working the job.

q: Can I give my own customers tracking access?
a: Yes — Clients can create read-only logins for their customers from the dashboard.

q: How do I get a dashboard login?
a: New clients receive access at booking; ask your Nedlloyd contact or email info@nedlloydgroup.com.

q: Do you send milestone alerts?
a: Milestone updates appear on the dashboard as they happen; email and WhatsApp alerts are being rolled out.

q: Can I export my shipment data?
a: Yes — CSV export is available from the dashboard.

q: Is the dashboard available on mobile?
a: Yes — it works in any mobile browser.

q: Are you hiring?
a: Yes — see the Careers page for open roles in operations, customs, business development and heavy haul.

q: How do I apply?
a: Use the apply form on the Careers page or email your CV to info@nedlloydgroup.com.

q: Do you take interns?
a: Yes, in operations and business development; write to us with your interest.

q: How can my company become a Nedlloyd vendor?
a: Use the Get a Quote form and choose Partner / Vendor, or email info@nedlloydgroup.com with your capabilities.

q: Do you partner with international forwarders?
a: Yes — through the WCA Network and direct partnerships; write to us to discuss reciprocal business.
